headline: SAFF holds 4.32 on Female Daily (1,746 reviews) for a fifteenth flat day, while new Shopee data puts SAFF 4th in local perfume share (3.52%), behind Mykonos and HMNS.
kpis_note: Awareness and NPS need a consumer survey; they are not measured from public web data.

insights.text: Female Daily flat vs yesterday: Alchemist 4.43, SAFF 4.32 (1,746 reviews), Mykonos 4.26, Onix 4.17, HMNS 4.15; no product moved. Mykonos dipped 0.01 vs 7 Nov.
Share gap: Compas Q2 2026 Shopee data ranks SAFF 4th at 3.52%, vs Mykonos 6.75% and HMNS 5.06%.
Marketplace ratings run far above Female Daily: S.O.F.R scores 4.9 from about 1,500 Tokopedia ratings, ILIAD 4.9 from about 2,900.
Unofficial resellers keep appearing: a non-official Tokopedia shop sells Troupe 30ml with no authorisation shown, after an 'inspired by' Coco copy earlier this week.
Short wear time is the most repeated weak point: Omnia's community profile shows about 3 hours with intimate sillage, in line with earlier SAFF and ILIAD projection reports.

recommendations.text: Report the 'inspired by' SAFFNCO Coco listing and unverified resellers to Tokopedia, and publish an authorised-reseller list plus a 'how to spot a fake' guide.
Counter Mykonos Soft Hour (in stores 15 Nov) with ads that use the 4.9 Tokopedia scores of S.O.F.R and ILIAD, and ask happy buyers to review on Female Daily too.
Align normal vs promo price messaging and stock across website, Tokopedia, Watsons and Zalora so constant markdowns and out-of-stock pages do not hurt trust.
Set clear longevity expectations per Extrait and Cloud Mist (hours on skin vs fabric) and add wear tips, starting with Omnia, S.O.T.B, ILIAD and Annabel Lee.
Run a quarterly survey (awareness, NPS) and upload a marketplace export to the Drive folder so low-star themes can be tracked.
